entitlement_key.description: Stable unique key for this organization entitlement, formatted as organization_id:feature_key.

feature_key.description: Platform feature or limit identifier, such as ce_training_portal, ce_cohorts, employee_seats, client_records, time_tracking, assessments, or custom_roles.

is_enabled.description: Controls whether this organization may use the feature.

limit_value.description: Optional numeric limit for this entitlement, such as allowed employee seats, client records, cohorts, trainer seats, or practitioner seats. Leave blank for features without a numeric limit.

entitlement_source.description: Why the organization has this entitlement.

starts_at.description: ISO timestamp when this entitlement becomes active.

ends_at.description: ISO timestamp when this entitlement expires, if applicable.

notes.description: Internal platform note explaining a custom entitlement or override.
